- Browser build: [official tagged source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liabru/matter-js/0.20.0/build/matter.min.js), stored unchanged as `matter-0.20.0.min.js`.
- License: MIT; full text copied unchanged from [the same tag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liabru/matter-js/0.20.0/LICENSE) into `MATTER-LICENSE.txt`.
